MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "A caliper would help me check bolt diameters and washer sizes, so it directly supports the fasteners I recently bought.",
    "The small Loctite bottle fits an occasional repair need without requiring me to buy a large supply."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Magnetic hooks help me hang things; their use of magnets does not mean I need a laboratory stirrer.",
    "The 3D pen and filaments assume a printing hobby that my recent purchases do not suggest, and the wire connectors require a wiring task I do not currently have.",
    "A second caliper would duplicate the one I selected, while ten bottles of glue exceed my occasional repair needs. The masks do not connect to my current hardware tasks."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Shared words such as magnetic seem to carry more weight than what I would actually use the item to do.",
    "My interest in practical hardware seems to have been stretched into an interest in unrelated making, printing, and laboratory supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent fasteners and hooks point toward measuring, fitting, and mounting things, so useful recommendations should support those tasks.",
    "I interact infrequently and need a clear immediate use; a possible future project is not enough to make me choose an item.",
    "Quantity and overlap matter: I need one suitable measuring tool and a modest amount of repair adhesive."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my practical hardware needs but extended them into unrelated activities and quantities I would not use."
}
